title: Proposal for Enforcement Powers under Animal and Birds Act to Be Given to Selected Non-Government Animal Welfare Groups
what_it_is: Proposal for Enforcement Powers under Animal and Birds Act to Be Given to Selected Non-Government Animal Welfare Groups

sections.label: Enforcement powers for NGOs
sections.summary: There is no current plan to give enforcement powers to non-governmental organisations, though international best practices will be studied when reviewing regulations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As of now, we do not plan to confer enforcement powers to non-governmental organisations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: However, we will study and learn from international best practices where appropriate, as we review and update our regulations.

sections.label: Animal cruelty cases and feedback
sections.summary: Animal cruelty cases are taken seriously and investigated, with no observed increase in cases though feedback has risen, and investigations face challenges like lack of evidence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Every time we read about cases of animal cruelty or abuse, we take those very seriously and we investigate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: However, just to clarify, based on our data, we have not observed an increase in the number of animal cruelty and abuse cases over the last few years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The number of feedback on animal cases has increased, partly because of greater public awareness of such issues.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: By far, the large majority of all the feedback is not related to animal abuse or cruelty.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: A very small proportion of the feedback is related to animal cruelty.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Having said that, there are indeed real challenges in terms of investigating those cases.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The challenges include, for example, a lack of eyewitnesses or direct evidence, for example, CCTV footage, or that carcasses have been disposed for some time and post-mortem analysis is not possible, or that cases are not reported or are reported late.
